sections.heading: How To Use?
sections.text:
1-After cleansing and toning apply dots all over the face and neck focusing on pigmented areas.

2-Smoothen till the skin absorbs it.

Caution - If you want to use the cream in the morning, avoid sun exposure as it may cause itching, irritation, and can catch dust.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Ayurvedic Papaya Pigmentation Anti-Blemish Cream

Your skin isn’t as flawless as you’d like it to be and you’re tired of ever-growing patches on your skin which are ruining your even skin tone. Correct? We’ve got you!

Let’s get that pigmentation under control, with the Ayurvedic benefits of Papaya and retinol-boosting goodness. Use generously morning and night for visible results in weeks. Our Ayurvedic Pigmentation Papaya Anti-Blemish Cream is a premium formula to eliminate unnatural skin spots caused by any skin concern. 

 ◙ NOTE:- 1) People with sensitive skin are advised to perform a patch test. If a rash, redness, or itching appears, stop using it.

2) The color formulation is caused by natural ingredients, which is completely normal and indicates that the product performs well. For best results, we recommend using our Papaya Pigmentation facewash. 

 

 

 
 <div class="

sections.heading: Ingredients
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 Ingredients
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Papaya Extract

A natural source of enzymes (Papain), papaya gently exfoliates dead skin cells, reduces dark spots, and promotes a brighter, more even skin tone.

Palmaria Palmata

Rich in antioxidants and nutrients, this marine extract supports skin renewal, helps combat pigmentation, and improves overall skin clarity and texture.

Licorice Root

Known for its brightening and soothing properties, licorice root helps reduce discoloration, calm irritated skin, and enhance natural radiance.

 

 

 
 <div class="

 Product Benefits
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 - Brightens skin and improves clarity

- Papain gently exfoliates for smoother texture

- Helps fade old marks and blemishes

- Lightweight, non-greasy daily formula

 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 1. Can I use it every day?

Yes! The formula is gentle and suitable for daily PM use.

2. How long does it take to see results?

Most users notice visible brightening in 2–3 weeks, with deeper pigmentation improving over consistent use.

3. Is it safe for sensitive skin?

Yes, the Papain-powered formula is mild and skin-friendly, but do a patch test if you have very sensitive skin.
